problem.title: Minimum Number of Pushes to Type Word Ii

approaches.title: Frequency Sorting with Grouped Push Costs
approaches.summary: Counts each letter's frequency, sorts frequencies in descending order, and assigns groups of eight letters increasing push costs. The total is the sum of each group's frequency multiplied by its cost.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial implementation uses a frequency vector, descending sort, and explicit index ranges to apply push costs from one to four.
Refactors the frequency storage to a fixed-size array and replaces explicit cost ranges with eight-element chunks and their group indices.
